## Big Picture

- Trade allows countries to specialise
- Comparative advantage is about relative costs
- Absolute advantage is not enough

## Main Equation

\[
a_{LC} / a_{LW} < a^*_{LC} / a^*_{LW}
\]

## A Block

::: {.block}
::: {.block-title}
Key idea
:::

Countries export goods in which they have comparative advantage.
:::

## Alert

::: {.alert}
Relative productivity matters, not absolute productivity.
:::
